headline: Sensex flat and Nifty trades near 23,800 as FII inflows offset IT stock losses

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Foreign institutional investors (FIIs/FPIs) return with buying inflows, supporting market sentiment.
Easing and soft crude oil prices provide relief to Indian equities.
Drag in major IT stocks limits market gains despite supportive global and foreign flows.
Investors actively assess foreign fund flows alongside US midterm election results.
whatHappening: Sensex remains stuck in a tight range while Nifty 50 trades around the 23,800 mark.
IT majors including TCS, Infosys, and HCL Tech lead market losses, dragging indices.
Smallcap and Midcap (SMID) stocks outperform the broader benchmark indices.
Shares of Equitas Small Finance Bank jump 9% after appointing Balaji Nuthalapadi as interim CEO.
summary: Indian benchmark indices trade flat today, with Nifty remaining near 23,800 amid mixed market signals. Market sentiment is supported by foreign institutional inflows and easing crude oil prices, balancing out significant drags in major IT stocks. Meanwhile, small and midcap stocks are outperforming, with strong individual moves seen in Equitas SFB and Q2 earnings focus stocks.
